svg.title: Storage placement and recovery boundaries
svg.desc: Every instance disk and custom volume lives on pool1. Logical separation does not create an off-host copy.

g.text: Every instance disk and custom volume lives on pool1. Logical separation does not create an off-host copy.
2 TB NVMe → ZFS pool1 (about 1.8 TB partition) → instance root disks + custom volumes
Incus profile: hourly instance snapshots, three-hour expiry
Custom volumes • excluded from instance snapshots
PostgreSQL cluster, WAL, and cluster logs
DNS: configuration; services: TLS / ACME state
PostgreSQL metadata and S3 blobs are external
Certificates and Secrets persist in etcd
Kuma: validated gzip SQLite backups; newest 14 kept.
Both repositories remain on the same Incus host.
Vault and etcd have no automatic snapshot jobs.
Harbor: database + blobs + local configuration / state.
Vault: Raft snapshot + original unseal shares;
TLS, configuration, and audit logs need separate copies.
Remove upgrade-specific rollback sets only after all upgrade checks pass. Routine retention and recovery credentials are
